answer_1.quote: We aim to evaluate the ability of LLMs to generate such programs when (1) the LLM has access to all the relevant information for generation, encoded in the assistant library documentation, or (2) the LLM selects the relevant primitives by exploring the entire assistant library as a first step prior to program generation.
answer_1.outputs: python programs that execute user requests using assistant library primitives

answer_2.quote: We report task success. A task is completed if the generated AEP executes without error and all assertions pass in all reference EPs.

answer_4.quote: Two annotators with similar expertise confirmed the data quality while carrying out the error analysis in §6.
answer_4.guideline: The lead author executed the tasks using syntax highlighting and auto-completion features to correct LLM output; two annotators with similar expertise confirmed data quality during error analysis.
